notes: Original-only blind extraction. Published 2011 article title/authors visually verified on PDF page 1; target methods and results visually verified on PDF pages 6–7 (printed pp. 408–409). The page-7 locator uniquely identifies the Study 3 dessert-choice comparison; Study 4 only begins on that page. Requested log_odds_ratio is not printed for this test; retained the printed chi-square statistic without conversion. Canonical text renders the printed Greek chi-square glyph as c2; rendered PDF confirms chi-square with df=1 and N=36, statistic 5.46 and p < .03. Quote preserves canonical OCR c2 and uses an explicit ellipsis to omit interleaved right-column text. N is established by the target test, not merely the recruited total. Replication and reported_success placeholders are unassigned, not acquisition failures.
